Hi Ben — thanks for the heads up. Happy to help. Quick answers below (we can provide raw exports if you need):

- Latency: median request latency improved from ~420ms to ~170ms (roughly 60% improvement) after moving to Redwood Dedicated in March.
- Cost-per-transaction: ~23% lower overall (Q2 vs Q1), primarily driven by better batching and prefix caching you helped tune.
- Availability: SLA has been met; we had 99.98% platform availability for token serving in Q2.
- Business outcome: We estimate these infra improvements reduced payment processing exceptions by ~12% and shortened dispute resolution time by an average of 1.6 days, which we conservatively estimate as $110k in monthly avoided friction for our top merchants.

You have permission to use the above headline metrics and a short quote: "Redwood’s serving improvements materially reduced our latency and processing overhead, driving direct savings and better merchant experience." Please attribute to: Emma Taylor, Head of Platform, AvaPay.

I’m attaching a CSV with the Q2 summary and our logo guidelines. If Legal needs to sign anything, loop them in (cc’d legal@avapay.com). Otherwise feel free to draft the one-pager and send for a quick sign-off.

Best,
Emma
Head of Platform | AvaPay
emma.taylor@avapay.com
